description: This file implements a service class for interacting with Grok's API via an OpenAI-compatible interface. It includes token usage tracking, context aggregation, and client creation functions, all tailored for Grok's API peculiarities. It also defines a dataclass for managing user and assistant context aggregators in Grok LLM interactions.

classes.name: GrokContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: A deprecated container class that holds a pair of context aggregators for user and assistant interactions within Grok LLM services, providing accessor methods.

classes.name: GrokLLMService
classes.description: A specialized service class for interacting with Grok's API, extending the OpenAILLMService to include token usage accumulation, context handling, and client creation tailored for Grok.

methods.name: GrokContextAggregatorPair.user
methods.description: Returns the user context aggregator instance.

methods.name: GrokContextAggregatorPair.assistant
methods.description: Returns the assistant context aggregator instance.

methods.name: GrokLLMService.__init__
methods.description: Constructor that initializes GrokLLMService with API key, base URL, model, and additional options, setting up token counters.

methods.name: GrokLLMService.create_client
methods.description: Creates an OpenAI-compatible client for the Grok API endpoint, optionally accepting API key and base URL overrides.

methods.name: GrokLLMService._process_context
methods.description: Overrides parent method to process a context and accumulate token usage metrics, finalizing reporting after completion.

methods.name: GrokLLMService.start_llm_usage_metrics
methods.description: Accumulates token usage metrics during processing by intercepting prompt, completion, cached, and reasoning tokens, deferring final report until process completion.

methods.name: GrokLLMService.create_context_aggregator
methods.description: Creates a pair of context aggregators (user and assistant) from an OpenAILLMContext, handling deprecated behavior and passing parameters.
